entry.title: Depot Operating Object Model: Ontologies for Unifying Factory Systems at a United States Vehicle Rebuild Depot
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for ontologies in discrete manufacturing in the United States: one fourteen-object operating model over the production control, inventory, maintenance and test cell systems of a government vehicle rebuild depot, read-only machine interfaces, three open-weight models on the depot's own two-card server, and a named person's sign-off on every release.

entry.title: Pipeline Integrity Watch: Leak Detection, Fleet Health and Security Directive Evidence for Natural Gas Transmission in the United States
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for pipeline integrity at a natural gas transmission operator in the United States, in oil and gas: passive OT network monitoring with self-generating TSA security directive evidence, compressor fleet health, leak and abnormal operation detection, a fourteen-object pipeline ontology, and four open-weight models on the operator's own hardware.

entry.title: Warehouse Twin Command: Live Slotting, Docks, Yards and Safety Vision for Warehousing and Intralogistics in the United States
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for a warehouse digital twin in the United States, in warehousing and intralogistics: a fourteen-object model projected over the WMS, labor and yard systems of four distribution centers, weekly slotting and dock and yard scheduling a person approves, safety vision on the existing cameras processed at each site, and every model on open weights the operator owns.

entry.title: Wayside Trend Watch: Predictive Maintenance From Wayside Detectors for a Freight Railroad in the United States
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for wayside detector predictive maintenance in the United States, in rail and transportation: cross-detector trending of 29 existing detectors keyed to serialized bearings and wheelsets, a fourteen-object ontology, edge vision at a four-camera yard portal, and one ranked queue on self-hosted open weights where a person decides every set out.

entry.title: Consist Watch: Executing the Operator's Own Fault Logic Across a 225-Car Commuter Fleet
entry.summary: Predictive maintenance and real time condition monitoring for a 225 car commuter rail fleet: onboard modules read 64 named signals per car, execute the operator's own fault logic at the car and send severity ranked faults to the mechanical desk through one fleet ontology. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: Turbine Island Watch: Condition Monitoring and Diagnostics for a Combined Cycle Plant in Pakistan
entry.summary: How we designed a steam turbine condition monitoring system for a combined cycle plant in Pakistan, from one-way OPC UA reads to alerts.

entry.title: Corridor Guard: Validated DC Interference Assessment and Mitigation for Every Gas Pipeline Near the Electrode Station
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for a validation-first DC interference study on buried gas pipelines near a high-voltage direct current electrode station in Pakistan, in oil and gas: a fifteen-object provenance-carrying register, one Apache-2.0 document parser, validated interference modelling, three gated phases, and a re-runnable model handed over on the operator's own 48 GB inference host.

entry.title: Hangar Form Cell: Dieless Robotic Sheet Metal From CAD to Certified Part Without Vendor Cloud
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for a dieless robotic sheet metal cell at an aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul facility in the United States, in aviation and aerospace manufacturing: dual-arm synchronized forming with generic styli, an offline CAD-to-path and springback compensation stack, in-process metrology, a fourteen-object Asset Administration Shell record per serialized part, two Apache-2.0 models on a cell edge box, and an eight-card 48 GB inference server behind a hardware data diode.

entry.title: Pit Camera Watch: An On-Premises Camera Monitoring System for Every Turn, Crossing and Pit Entry on the Test Site
entry.summary: Camera monitoring design for a US vehicle proving ground: owned L40S recorder hosts priced against AWS g6e.xlarge at 1.861 dollars an hour. By CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: Field Ledger: An Open Source Agriculture Data Dashboard the Operator Fully Owns
entry.summary: An open source farm data dashboard for agriculture in Pakistan: live field sensor feeds, historical datasets and an analytics repository joined in one 12 object model on PostgreSQL and PostGIS, drill-down by farm, crop cycle and season, owned in full by the operator. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: Fodder Watch: Earth Observation That Turns Restricted-Crop Detections Into Enforceable Case Files
entry.summary: An earth observation system design that screens farm parcels with Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1 and Landsat, turns restricted crop detections into enforceable case files, and keeps imagery, weights and detections in the Kingdom. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: Baseline: One Flight of 4 Band Orthoimagery and LiDAR for Vegetation Mapping
entry.summary: An earth observation system design for one summer flight of 3-inch 4 band orthoimagery and Quality Level 1 LiDAR, with every tile, point cloud and elevation model bound into a site ontology the operator's own analysts work in the GIS they already run, so the next season starts from a comparison. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: Grid Context Watch: One system of context for OT Security and NERC CIP Evidence
entry.summary: From a CISA advisory on actively exploited vulnerabilities to a closed finding: OT security monitoring and NERC CIP audit evidence for a US utility, passive and one way out of the control networks, on the operator's own hardware. Grid Context Watch, an open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: Reliability Atlas: A Plant Reliability Assessment Study the Operator Can Audit
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for a records-based reliability and availability assessment across the desalination and treatment plants of an energy and utilities operator in Saudi Arabia: three record sources joined into a thirteen-object reliability model the operator owns, auditable to ISO 55000, with no model to serve and no hardware to buy.

entry.title: Loop Integrity Watch: Ending Distorted Radar Level Readings and Tank-to-Tank Swapping Across the Tank Farm
entry.summary: A tank gauging system design for a fuel terminal tank farm in Pakistan: radar level gauges on three Modbus RTU loops restored by survey-sized boosters, and a governed inventory ontology that flags stuck, distorted or swapped tank level readings before the central picture misleads anyone. Loop Integrity Watch, an open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: Factory Fire Watch: Read-Only Smart Fire Protection Monitoring for Every High-Risk Factory
entry.summary: Remote fire protection monitoring for high-risk factories in Saudi Arabia: live, read-only status of fire alarm panels, fire pumps and fire water tanks, read through panel contacts, PLC inputs and LoRaWAN into an IoT platform hosted in the Kingdom, never a write path into life-safety equipment. Factory Fire Watch, an open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: From Reference Architecture to Living Ontology: the hyper-ontology/1 Package and Hyper Ontology
entry.summary: How a Praxis design's object model is packaged as hyper-ontology/1, what seven published packages contain, how to load and convert them, and how Hyper Ontology stands a package up as a living system over an operator's own systems of record.

entry.title: Port Twin: One Governed Digital Twin for Every Asset, Feed and Dollar
entry.summary: A port authority digital twin architecture that binds eight operational systems, five live sensor feeds and the finance backbone into one thirteen object ontology, self hosted on the port's own virtual machines in the United States. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: Steel Count Ledger: Independently Counted Production for Every Steel Mill in Pakistan
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for independent production counting at steel melting and re-rolling mills in Pakistan: cameras and GPU industrial PCs at every installation point count billets, ingots, rebars and girders, publish into one operator-owned record, and let revenue officers reconcile counted against declared production, with a fourteen-object ontology, a frontier model behind an export licence checkpoint, and a three-year cost comparison.

entry.title: Structure Phase Watch: Live Production, Crane and Delivery Evidence for Every Pour on a Construction Site
entry.summary: A construction progress monitoring system design that joins precast production, crane utilisation and truck flow into one live model of the structure phase, forecasts schedule slips three days out and shows safety breaches as they happen, on the contractor's own hardware in the Kingdom. An open reference architecture by CodeNinja Atoms.

entry.title: Sovereign HSE Watch: A Reference Architecture for Predictive Health, Safety and Environment Intelligence in Pakistan's Oil and Gas Operations
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for a sovereign, air-gapped HSE platform for an oil and gas operator in Pakistan: eight source systems, a twelve-object ontology, six self-hosted open-weight models on one GPU node, and a three-year cost comparison against cloud.

entry.title: Terminal Pulse: Predicted Truck Turn Time and Live Yard Sight for a Container Terminal
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for predicting truck turn time two hours out and seeing yard congestion live at a container terminal in the United States: eleven source systems, a twelve-object ontology, edge vision at the yard and gate, a frontier model on the operator's own hardware, and a three-year cost comparison against cloud.

entry.title: Feeder Firewatch: Live Ignition and Outage Risk for Every Distribution Feeder
entry.summary: An open reference architecture for live wildfire ignition and outage risk at an electric distribution cooperative in the United States: twelve source systems, a fourteen-object ontology, self-hosted open-weight models on the cooperative's own hardware, every de-energisation approved by a named operator, and a three-year cost comparison against cloud.
